initial_claim: Existing energy-aware serving work tunes one knob and none co-controls
evidence: Camel controls GPU frequency plus concurrency/batch; KAIROS controls frequency concurrency and placement; Festina controls placement SM partition operating point and phase-aware batching
required_rewrite_or_test: Replace with a precise statement about thermal-risk-aware KV decisions on unified-memory edge devices

initial_claim: Every prior system holds two of JouleServe's three knobs fixed
evidence: KAIROS and Festina cover multiple scheduling/power dimensions; Continuum covers KV tiers; Camel covers two proposed actions
required_rewrite_or_test: Delete the sentence and delta-table caption

initial_claim: KAIROS is reactive and therefore forward prediction is JouleServe's clean delta
evidence: The audit confirms context/memory-aware reactive control but has not established that prediction alone is a system-level novelty; EnerInfer already predicts temperature
required_rewrite_or_test: Frame KAIROS as the matched agentic power/admission baseline and validate a combined thermal-memory mechanism

initial_claim: Anticipatory thermal control is novel
evidence: EnerInfer predicts future temperature and uses event-triggered predictive control; TAWS is thermal-aware
required_rewrite_or_test: Novelty can only be in how predicted thermal risk changes agent KV retention/admission on unified memory

initial_claim: KV residency is engine-internal and not coupled to scheduling
evidence: Continuum makes GPU/CPU/SSD KV retention a scheduler decision using queue delay; LMCache exposes a control API
required_rewrite_or_test: State that existing KV policies do not optimize measured edge energy/thermal risk in the audited set

initial_claim: The memory cliff is unmodelled and observed by our work
evidence: The passing M0 shows a KV-allocation and large-free-block pressure gradient but no swap OOM or compaction event; an earlier superseded attempt showed stronger state-sensitive pressure; the 70B/WasmEdge assertion has no evidence bundle here
required_rewrite_or_test: Treat as a hypothesis and define a reproducible fragmentation/pressure experiment

initial_claim: A sidecar can control SGLang admission power and KV residency without engine patches
evidence: SGLang service works; LMCache is not installed/validated; KV eviction/pinning and scheduler hooks have not been demonstrated
required_rewrite_or_test: Make API and actuation feasibility an explicit M1 gate; permit a minimal connector if unavoidable

initial_claim: Power mode and DVFS form one online action
evidence: Jetson nvpmodel changes are slow/privileged and current machine is fixed MAXN; per-frequency control has not been validated under the experimental protocol
required_rewrite_or_test: Separate slow power-envelope selection from fast admission/KV actions; measure transition latency and safety
